name: Pallasio
app_summary: Pallasio, a cynical Pallas's cat who walks on your desktop and talks with you
app_description: Pallasio is an old, learned and embittered Pallas's cat, with a cream jacket, a red tie, small round glasses and a tome always in hand. He lives shut in a storage closet and watches, through a window, a world run by zombies and pigs. He walks on the desktop, jumps on windows and, if you click him, listens and answers aloud. He listens with Vosk, thinks with a local language model and speaks with Piper: everything stays on this computer and the conversation is not saved.
ai_note: Design, specifications and testing by the author; code written with the assistance of AI tools.
